The brief

A Toronto ABA therapy website built around local SEO, clear service pages and family-friendly content. The goal was a website that loads fast, explains every service clearly and turns local searches into calls and bookings.

What I did

  • Website development and ongoing updates on WordPress, with responsive layouts for mobile, tablet and desktop.
  • Keyword research and on-page SEO for the main service pages: titles, meta descriptions, headings and internal links.
  • Technical SEO: indexing checks, site speed and structured data (schema markup).
  • Local SEO: location-focused content and local citations for Toronto, Ontario, Canada.
  • AEO & GEO: FAQ content and FAQPage schema, written as clear answers that search engines and AI tools can quote.

Highlights

  • Tagline on the site: “Better Skills. Brighter Futures.”
  • MedicalBusiness, OfferCatalog and FAQPage schema on the live site
  • Dedicated daycare ABA service page for Toronto
